message: I created this little corner of the internet just for you. Have a look around, there are notes, memories, and more to come.

notes.text: You make ordinary days feel like my favourite ones.
Don’t forget to drink water. Love you!

timeline.title: The day I built this
timeline.text: I wanted a place to keep all the little things I love about us.
